mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals a tightening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both decline.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals an economic slowdown that reduces corporate investment and earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO 3-month change < 0.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales series (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window when RSAFS rises.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rises in employment (PAYEMS) signal a robust labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS rises.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and rises in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal an economic contraction that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO 3-month change < 0 AND UNRATE 3-month change > 0.
